sourcePlan.task.inputForm: 完整文字任务 + 随题分析属性表（待编制）
sourcePlan.task.scenario: 两层2乘1跨，重力与X/Y侧力分别给定，三个组合；完整属性按公共契约随题给出。 跨长X为6+6m、Y为5m，层高3.6m；D梁8kN/m，右后角逐层Wx=10/20kN、Wy=8/16kN；求D、D+Wx、D+Wy。
sourcePlan.task.modelingFocus: 两个水平分量及组合响应定位
sourcePlan.task.expectedOutput: 同一角点每层X/Y位移、各柱列双向层间差、柱脚反力向量及控制组合标识。
sourcePlan.task.gradingFocus: 两个水平分量及组合响应定位；指定位置/分量对照数值真值，输出文字与结构化结果保持符号、单位和工况一致。
sourcePlan.task.prerequisite: 多组合执行契约需验证；完整题面、参数/单位契约与真值待验证
sourcePlan.model.topologyKey: 空间两层X两跨Y一跨框架
sourcePlan.model.boundaryKey: 全部柱脚六自由度固定
sourcePlan.model.loadKey: D梁线载；Wx/Wy右后角分层侧力；三个组合
sourcePlan.model.propertyKey: 单钢材料；梁柱分组截面及局部轴
sourcePlan.engine.analysisContract: 保留题定几何、材料截面、边界、全部目标输出及一阶线弹性静力；自重关闭，不新增刚性楼板、刚域或默认组合。梁线载/单向受荷宽度严格按题，禁止自动双向传载或面线载叠加；原生 DL/LL、坐标轴、单位、工况/组合须有显式对应。
sourcePlan.engine.executionRequirement: 拟要求真实 YJK 原生建模和求解，并交付关联本题的项目、计算日志及原始结果；OpenSees 替代或仅生成兼容文件不能计作原生计算完成。
sourcePlan.engine.requiredEvidence: 拟保存（尚未生成）：YJK 版本、独立模型/项目标识、节点构件属性及荷载审计表、原生计算日志、原始结果文件；位移/端力/反力逐项关联模型、构件、工况与单位。
sourcePlan.engine.adapterGap: 现有输入仅楼面 DL/LL，缺题定右后角逐层 X/Y 节点侧力；D、D+Wx、D+Wy 的显式组合映射未验证，须补输入和结果索引。另须验收自重关闭、无刚性楼板、轴系/单位及题定工况到原生设置的映射；未实际运行。
sourcePlan.engine.truthPlan: 拟在 YJK 中独立建模并人工审定输入、版本和分析设置，生成本题全部要求的位移/内力/反力同引擎标答；独立 D/Wx/Wy 杆系解和叠加，逐项复核双向基底剪力与倾覆力矩。旧值仅作线索，不直接继承；跨引擎仅校核，不以 OpenSees 唯一判卷。尚未生成。

turns.instruction:
Required solver: YJK.
Use YJK native analysis for a two-story steel space frame with X bays 6+6 m, Y bay 5 m and 3.6 m story heights. All six bases are fixed in six DOFs. D is 8 kN/m downward on every floor beam. At the right rear corner (12,5), apply Wx in +X: 10 kN at floor 1 and 20 kN at floor 2; Wy is a separate +Y case with 8 and 16 kN at those same levels. Analyze combinations C0=D, CX=D+Wx and CY=D+Wy independently. Report X/Y corner displacements at both levels, X/Y story differences on all column lines, six-component base reactions and the governing combination for each requested displacement, drift and reaction component. Retain the signed value of each maximum-absolute response.

Use all public appendices. Report the complete requested numerical table and the required summaries.

authoringNotes: The source leaves the property appendix to the author. Frozen sections: X beams B1 solid rectangle 300x600 mm, Y beams B2 solid rectangle 300x700 mm, columns C1 solid square 500x500 mm. E/G, A/Iy/Iz/J and local reference vectors are explicit in public input; no section catalog or solver defaults apply.
All story drift requests are signed upper-node displacement minus lower-node displacement, for every existing column line. No diaphragm average replaces column-line results.
Broad source terms such as representative beam/column end forces are resolved by requesting all relevant members, rather than omitting an unspecified representative location.
